item.title: Best video game line of all time
item.author: invalid@example.com (natjjohn)

item.content:encoded: So it's in Octopath Traveler 0, when Auguste throws his hands to the sky and yells, "Marvelous!" I'm sure there's other good dialogue across video game history, but very few things bring a smile to people's faces as much as Auguste dropping a Marvelous. EDIT: Seeing all the videos. Actually can't find any Auguste marvelous videos as they all seem to not use the voice actor from Octopath 0. So guessing it's the mobile version or a different region.
